assessment.summary: Async correctness concerns — The exported promise resolves before any of the per-job work is guaranteed to complete.

findings.title: Async work is discarded by forEach
findings.summary: An async callback is passed to forEach, which does not observe or await the returned promises.
findings.whyItMatters: The containing operation can complete before the callback work, and callback rejections can escape the intended error path.

evidence.message: An async callback is passed to forEach, which does not observe or await the returned promises.

findings.recommendation: Use an awaited loop for ordered work or await Promise.all over an explicit map for intentional concurrency.

opinion.summary: I would address discarded asynchronous callback work before merging.
